sentences.text: No: for an existing floating-rate term loan sanctioned before 31 December 2025 for purposes other than business to an individual borrower, a UCB shall not charge pre-payment charges.

The rule for loans sanctioned or renewed on or after 1 January 2026 also says a UCB shall not levy pre-payment charges on all floating-rate loans granted for purposes other than business to individuals, but that rule is not the one that matches a 31 December 2025 sanction date.
